name: scrumia-kotlin-multiplatform-mobile
description: The Kotlin Multiplatform Mobile implementation slot — a composition preset carrying KMP-specific rules: expect/actual across source sets, source-set layout (commonMain, androidMain, iosMain, the JVM desktop target), iOS/Android split, Cocoapods and Swift interop, target declaration, KMP-shaped Gradle wiring. Re-exports six satellites (scrumia-kotlin, scrumia-gradle, scrumia-ktor, scrumia-material3, scrumia-effect, scrumia-functional-programming) by configuration, not by code. Plugs in app by app.
